## Install on an Android tablet

1. On the tablet, open this page and tap **KesfetCode.apk** to download it.
2. Open the downloaded file. If Android asks, allow your browser or Files app to **install unknown apps**, then tap **Install**.
   - Honor tablets (MagicOS) may show an extra security check; choose to continue installing.
3. Open **Keşfet Code** from the home screen.

## Updates

The app updates itself. Each time it opens, it checks for a newer version of the game and installs it in a few seconds, so every tablet runs the same version. You only need to download a new APK from here if the app shows a message asking you to.
